newsitem.title: NORWAY: Nera forecasts volume growth at 10-15 pct.
newsitem.headline: Nera forecasts volume growth at 10-15 pct.

text.p: Norwegian telecommunications company Nera ASA sees volume growth of 10 to 15 percent as "realistic", group chairman Frode Botnevik said on Wednesday.
But Botnevik warned that competition made for greater uncertainty over operating margins this year.

"In the short term, cost cuts and continued restructuring of the company must go hand in hand with an all out investment in product development and marketing," Botnevik told reporters after the company released first-half 1997 results.
